notes: License fee amounts come from the department's staggered fee chart, dated 2015; the department says fees follow the weight and year of the vehicle.
Plate mailing ($12) and registration mailing ($2.50) fees are not included.
Registration is renewed in the month set by the first letter of the owner's last name; the first payment can cover more or fewer months than 12.

content.intro: {state} charges a {stateRate} excise tax on the purchase price of a vehicle, instead of a sales tax. Registration is paid every year and depends on the vehicle's weight and age.

howItWorks.text: The excise tax is {stateRate} of the purchase price on most motor vehicles. The credit or trade-in value allowed by the seller is deducted from the price.
For a vehicle bought outside the state, proof of tax paid is required when you apply for a title, and you may owe more tax.
License fees depend on the weight and year of the vehicle, and vehicles ten or more years old pay less.

faq.q: Does South Dakota charge sales tax on a car?
faq.text: It charges an excise tax on the purchase price instead of a sales tax.

faq.q: Does a trade-in lower the excise tax?
faq.text: Yes, the credit or trade-in value allowed by the seller is deducted from the price.
